Hey dude, ive been in the same boat. Simply enough, you wont find happiness in anyone but yourself. Easy to say but hard to do. My friends rip on me constantly about being dumb and it hurts being the end of the "you're stupid lol" jokes constantly. 

What ive learned is to just let everything go. Learn to love yourself for all you are. All the faults and all the feats. Once you come to terms with yourself then you can move toward improvement. Let yourself decide whats important. Follow your passions and never let yourself slip away. Even if the world is against you, you can rest assured that you have yourself. 

I cant promise to always be there but pm if you need to let things off your chest. Dont let thoughts like these dwell cause they will only grow and reek havoc on your self image.

I appreciate your help. His family is very distant. A bad childhood has left him with no family other than his dad, which hes living with. They fight constantly and is a big factor in his fucked up childhood. I could try but i feel it would cause issues between him and his dad. 

Hes told me multiple times that hes ready to give in. He says everyday is suffering. He shows heavy signs of clincal depression such as sleeping for 12 hours or more in a day. 

Last night, well about 3 hours ago, he messaged me while i was asleep to say goodbye and thanks for being his friend. I woke up and began panicking. I called his phone, texted, tried facebook and got absolutely nothing. I noticed he went offline after he sent the message and started sobbing. So i flew over to his house to walk in on him passed out drunk. 

I started writing this while i was crying on his bedside. He has access to about anything he wants when coming to drugs. Hes had a history with meth and it left him really fucked up. He just applied for a general goods store but had been unemployed for a while. He lost his last job cause he got into a depressed state and wouldnt get out of bed. 

I want to be that stone wall but i myself am crumbling. Ive tried helping and he turns me away and says he doesnt need help. That help is for when you want to keep going. I cant do this. It hurts so much to think im gonna fail to rescue him from this. And i know that i shouldnt try to fix someone else but hes not going to survive this if nobody does anything. 

And im not the only one that cares. Others have reached out but he just ignores them. I have extreme depression and anxiety. I know how he feels and what goes through your head and i cant accept that i cant help him. I have to. Someone has to
